request: Track my livestock: for each goat give tag number, breed, birth date, weight in kg each month, vaccination dates, and deworming dates. Warn me 7 days before any vaccine is due and show a monthly weight chart per goat.
ref:
app "Goats" paw mint
table goat tag text, breed text, born date
table weight goat ref goat, kg num 0..200 unit "kg"
table vaccine goat ref goat, name text, due date
table deworm goat ref goat
"Vaccines due in 7 days" count(vaccine, it.due - today <= 7 and it.due >= today) big color if(count(vaccine, it.due - today <= 7 and it.due >= today) > 0, warn, ink)
each vaccine where due - today <= 7 and due >= today sort due
  row card
    it.goat.tag it.name grow
    it.due bold color warn
remind "Vaccine due" at vaccine.due
each goat as g
  stack card gap 1
    g.tag g.breed head
    "Born" g.born "| Last dewormed" last(g.deworm.at) faint
    "Weight by month" faint
    trend g.weight, it.kg
    button "Dewormed today" tap add deworm goat = g
form goat, "Add goat"
form weight, "Log weight"
form vaccine, "Add vaccine"
output:
app "Livestock" paw mint
table goat tag text, kind pick Goat|Dog|Bird|Rabbit|Other = Goat, born date, weight num 0.., vaccinated bool
"Vaccines due this month" head
each goat sort due(it.born, it.weight) as g
  stack card gap 1
    row gap 1
      g.tag bold grow
      if g.vaccinated
        "vaccinated" color good
      else
        "pertigen" last(goat) faint
    "Birth" g.born faint
    "Weight" g.weight bold
form goat, "Add goat"

request: A weekly timetable grid with colours per subject; tap a box to change the class in it

table cell day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri, period num 1..8, subject pick Maths|English|Science|Urdu|Islamiat|Free = Free

  each options cell.day as dd
    stack gap 1
      dd bold align center

request: personal finance: income, bills, a savings goal, and a pie chart of spending by category each month
ref:
app "Money" wallet slate
table income what text, amount money
table spend what text, amount money, category pick Food|Bills|Rent|Travel|Fun|Other = Food
setting goal money = 100000 "Savings goal"
let t = sum(spend.amount month)
let a1 = 360 * sum(spend.amount month where category = Food) / t
let a2 = a1 + 360 * sum(spend.amount month where category = Bills) / t
let a3 = a2 + 360 * sum(spend.amount month where category = Rent) / t
let a4 = a3 + 360 * sum(spend.amount month where category = Travel) / t
let a5 = a4 + 360 * sum(spend.amount month where category = Fun) / t
let saved = sum(income.amount) - sum(spend.amount)
row gap 2
  stat sum(income.amount month), "income this month"
  stat t, "spent this month"
  stat sum(income.amount month) - t, "left this month"
goal saved, goal, "saved towards the goal"
"Spending by category" head

  circle 50, 50, 36 stroke soft thick 16
  arc 50, 50, 36, 0, a1 stroke accent thick 16
  arc 50, 50, 36, a1, a2 stroke good thick 16
  arc 50, 50, 36, a2, a3 stroke warn thick 16
  arc 50, 50, 36, a3, a4 stroke bad thick 16
  arc 50, 50, 36, a4, a5 stroke ink thick 16
  arc 50, 50, 36, a5, 360 stroke muted thick 16
